payload.name: Extract Explicit Facts from Emotional Statements
payload.description: Use during extraction when a message pairs an emotional or preference statement with an explicit factual assertion, such as a specific date, event, or relationship detail.
content: During extraction, if a message contains both an emotional/preference statement and an explicit factual assertion (e.g., 'This is my parents' wedding in 1993'), create a separate candidate for the factual assertion in addition to any preference candidate.

Record explicit dates/events as an event or relationship memory (e.g., 'Deborah's parents married in 1993') with the year in the content and world_start instead of embedding the fact only in a general preference.
Extract only facts explicitly stated; stop once the distinct assertions are captured and do not infer unmentioned dates or details.

solves: When construction extraction collapses a message that mixes feelings with concrete facts, it loses answerable facts like dates of past events. This skill ensures explicit factual assertions in narrative or emotional messages are extracted as their own durable memory.
